segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Develops and sells at-home compression therapy devices for lymphedema and a wearable airway clearance vest for chronic respiratory conditions, reimbursed by insurers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Insurers, including private payers, Medicare, the Veterans Administration and certain Medicaid programs, pay for the lymphedema and airway clearance devices provided to patients.
revenueModel.evidence: We are a national, accredited provider of home medical equipment services approved for coverage by private payers, Medicare, the Veterans Administration and certain Medicaid programs in the United States.
